description: Generate a short video clip (with synchronized audio) from a text prompt using LTX-2.3 on the host MLX layer (Apple Silicon). Synchronous and slow — a ~4s clip takes several minutes. Output is preview-grade; keep clips to ~4-6s.
name: generate_video

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

model.description: ltx-2.3-q4 (int4, lighter/faster) or ltx-2.3-q8 (int8, higher quality, heavier)

frames.description: Frame count; snapped to the nearest 8k+1 (97 ≈ 4s @ 24fps)

description: Animate a still image into a short video clip (image-to-video) using LTX-2.3 on the host MLX layer. Provide image_url (a public http(s) URL or an already-uploaded file name) plus a prompt describing the motion. Synchronous and slow (several minutes).
name: animate_image

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL or an already-uploaded workspace file name of the source image

prompt.description: Description of the motion / what should happen in the clip

frames.description: Frame count; snapped to the nearest 8k+1
